problem.title: Property visibility breaks when location and enquiry paths do not connect
problem.body: Dubai property searches combine area, property type, purpose, and practical details. When listing, community, and agency pages use inconsistent signals or lead visitors into unclear enquiry routes, relevant inventory becomes harder to discover and act on.

method.title: Build property discovery around areas, inventory, and intent
method.intro: The method aligns Dubai property pages with how people narrow a search, while keeping technical and editorial work tied to useful enquiry journeys.

steps.title: Map Dubai property demand
steps.body: Organise Dubai property themes around areas, property types, sale or rental intent, and the pages that can answer each search without creating overlapping destinations.

steps.title: Strengthen location signals
steps.body: Connect Dubai community pages, property pages, business details, and local signals so search engines and visitors can understand where each offer is relevant.

steps.title: Open inventory crawl paths
steps.body: Review Dubai property filters, pagination, canonicals, internal links, and stale listing states, using automated checks to support focused inspection rather than replace it.

steps.title: Clarify property enquiry routes
steps.body: Shape Dubai property calls to action and supporting content around the questions that matter before an enquiry, then verify that priority pages lead to a clear contact path.

outcome.title: A clearer route from property search to informed enquiry
outcome.body: Dubai property teams receive a prioritised plan that links search demand, location relevance, inventory access, and enquiry usability without treating each page as an isolated optimisation task.
points: Dubai area and property themes assigned to distinct pages
Location signals aligned across relevant property routes
Priority inventory reachable through dependable crawl paths
Enquiry journeys supported by useful property information
